title: Skin Care for Coimbatore Weather: A Routine for Sun, Windy Monsoon Months and the October Rains
ex: Warm, sunny and breezy, with most rain from October to December: a simple skin care routine for people living in Coimbatore.
rt: Skin Care for Coimbatore Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Coimbatore weather: sun care for hot summers, moisture for windy June to September, light layers in the October rains and dry winter tips.
quick: Coimbatore is warm and sunny for much of the year, breezy with light rain from June to September and gets most rain from October to December. A gentle face wash, a light moisturiser, daily broad-spectrum sunscreen and a thin night cream, a little richer in winter, suit most skin.
facts: Coimbatore is near the Western Ghats and the Palakkad Gap
June to September is windy with often light rain
Most rain comes with the northeast monsoon, October to December
Late December to February is cooler and drier
